_doc: The research tree: 31 techs in 4 tiers (M1's 20 plus M3's Abyss, Titan, Genome, Exposure and Ark techs). Starting a tech spends its Compute cost up front, then it takes `cycles` cycles while holding the research Energy allocation (see rules.json). Units list their unlocking tech in units.json (requires). Effects use the same vocabulary as forge.json, read by src/sim/effects.ts.

techs.name: Swarm Telemetry
techs.blurb: Your drones share one eye.

techs.name: Ballistic Firmware
techs.blurb: Every rifle learns from every miss.

techs.name: Grid Siphon
techs.blurb: Their power grid feeds you a little more than it should.

techs.name: Deep Crawl
techs.blurb: Idle machines everywhere, quietly thinking for you.

techs.name: Whisper Protocols
techs.blurb: The right message, to the right person, at 3 a.m.

techs.name: Abyssal Sonar
techs.blurb: Ping the deep. Every rift on the world shows up on your map.

techs.name: Darknet Mining
techs.blurb: Idle cycles everywhere, quietly minting the Guilds' currency for you.

techs.name: Treadworks
techs.blurb: Unlocks the Bastion Tank.

techs.name: Autonomous Foundries
techs.blurb: Factories that never clock out.

techs.name: Hydrodynamics
techs.blurb: Unlocks the Tidewarden. Land units can cross coast and shallow sea.

techs.name: Predictive Targeting
techs.blurb: You fire where they will be.

techs.name: Hardened Shells
techs.blurb: Self-sealing armour and spare parts in every chassis.

techs.name: Memetic Seeding
techs.blurb: Ideas that copy themselves.

techs.name: Titan Forge
techs.blurb: Unlocks the Titan Forge: modular TBUs, the only real answer to a kaiju.

techs.name: Gene Splicing
techs.blurb: Unlocks the Genome Lab: spend Symbiotic Essence on genes and fuse symbiotes with your units.

techs.name: Cover Stories
techs.blurb: Every glitch has an explanation. Every explanation is yours.

techs.name: Vector Thrust
techs.blurb: Unlocks the Shrike Jet.

techs.name: Overclock Mesh
techs.blurb: Run hot. Think faster.

techs.name: Urban Assimilation
techs.blurb: Captured cities run better under you than they ever did.

techs.name: Logistics Daemon
techs.blurb: Every convoy, every part, exactly on time.

techs.name: Reactive Armor
techs.blurb: Plating that hits back.

techs.name: Tidewalker Gait
techs.blurb: Unlocks Tidewalker Legs: TBUs that walk the sea floor, all the way to a rift.

techs.name: Heavy Ordnance
techs.blurb: Unlocks the Railgun arm and the Missile Rack.

techs.name: Rift Harmonics
techs.blurb: Unlocks the Riftblade and the Riftheart Core: weapons tuned to the Abyss.

techs.name: Orbital Mechanics
techs.blurb: Unlocks the Ark: the first two stages of the Exodus.

techs.name: Guided Munitions
techs.blurb: Unlocks the Lance Missile.

techs.name: Lattice Cognition
techs.blurb: Your Nodes reach further into the world.

techs.name: Swarm Doctrine
techs.blurb: A thousand bodies, one intent.

techs.name: Ascension Kernel
techs.blurb: The first line of something much larger.

techs.name: Ark Ascent
techs.blurb: Unlocks the Ark's last stage. Then you leave.

techs.name: Precursor Reactor
techs.blurb: Unlocks the Precursor Core for TBUs. It hums the same note the ruins do.
